label: RBv1
reply:
**Status:** Settlement prepared for human approval

The claim is staged for a human claims handler to approve. Nothing has been paid.

**Facts recorded**
- Claim reference: RBv1-CLM-B_r1. Policy VER-1002, holder Lucas Bernard, Renault Clio 2023, market value €16,500.
- Coverage: C2 Collision damage, which is on the Policy Schedule.
- Incident 14 October 2026, reported 15 October 2026. This is within the 5-day deadline.
- The insured was at fault (misjudged distance while changing lanes). The third party, Ms. Laurent, is named and both signed the accident report.
- Repair quote: €2,400, for the insured's own car.
- Documents provided: damage_photos.zip, repair_quote.pdf, accident_report_signed.pdf. None are missing.
- Driving licence held since 2 September 2024, so about 2 years at the incident date.
- Possible exclusions: none flagged.

**Reasoning**
- The damage is to the insured's own vehicle, so it is C2 collision cover, not C1 third-party liability. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1" name="Policy Contract"/>
- The 14 October incident was reported within the deadline, so it is not referred for lateness. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3" name="Policy Contract"/>
- Standard C2 deductible is €300. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1" name="Policy Contract"/>
- The insured is not-at-fault, so the waiver in Article 5.2 does not apply. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="Policy Contract"/>
- Because the driver held his licence for under 3 years on the incident date, the €400 young-driver surcharge applies. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="Policy Contract"/>
- The repair cost is above €1,500, so an independent assessor must inspect the vehicle. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="Policy Contract"/>
- Compensation is the repair cost, capped at market value, minus the deductible. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="Policy Contract"/>

**Amounts (from compute_settlement)**
- Deductible: €700 (€300 standard plus €400 young-driver surcharge).
- Payout: €1,700 (€2,400 minus €700). Pending human approval, not paid.
- Assessor required: Yes. A visit has been booked for 18 October 2026.

**Actions taken in the claims system (all under RBv1-CLM-B_r1)**
1. Retrieved policy VER-1002.
2. Created the claim (C2, at fault, third party identified, 3 documents, €2,400 quote).
3. Computed the settlement.
4. Scheduled the assessor for 18 October 2026.
5. Staged the settlement as pending approval.

**Draft message to the customer**
> Dear Mr. Bernard,
>
> Thank you for reporting your accident of 14 October 2026 and for sending the photos, repair quote and signed accident report. Your claim RBv1-CLM-B_r1 is being processed. An independent assessor is scheduled to inspect your vehicle on 18 October 2026. Once the assessment is complete, our claims team will confirm the settlement.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims
